history.p: Gade end-dated his score on 12 March 1852, six days before the first performance in Musikforeningen, and offered it to Breitkopf & Härtel three weeks later hoping that it would then be performed at the Gewandhaus shortly after. However, the first performance in Leipzig did not take place until Gade returned to Leipzig in January 1853.

physDesc.physMedium: Bound in turquoise cardboard cover with cloth spine. Written in ink. Paper: 14 staves. From first music page paginated pp. 1- 101. Last page blank. The printed German text by Edmund Lobedanz is glued to the flyleaf. Heading on p. 1: "Frühlingsphantasie" / I. In upper left-hand corner: "8571" being the plate no. of the printed score. After the last double bar-line: "Fine / 12te März 52." and Gade's musical signature.
